stations.title: Route planner
stations.text: Five commits of wip and typo.
stations.note: Never pushed, so safe to rewrite.

captions: Ines will review your route planner, but not five commits called wip.
The planner works, but its history reads like a scratch pad.
You write the commands that tidy it, in three tasks.
One commit on top of main, with a message Ines can use.
Same files, cleaner history. The backup is there if anything slips.
